title: Washington sees in the dark
pull: Seventy five rounds of 16 inch in the dark

facts.text: USS Washington (BB-56), a North Carolina class battleship, was built at the Philadelphia Navy Yard and commissioned on 15 May 1941.
On the night of 14 to 15 November 1942 she was the flagship of Rear Admiral Willis A. Lee, a gunnery man and student of radar, commanding Task Force 64: Washington, South Dakota and four destroyers.
All four US destroyers were knocked out early: Walke, Preston and Benham were lost and Gwin was damaged. Then South Dakota lost electrical power and drew most of the Japanese fire.
Unseen, Washington used her radar to close on the battleship Kirishima and opened fire at about 8,400 yards, point blank range for 16 inch guns.
She fired 75 rounds of 16 inch and 107 of 5 inch ammunition, scoring at least nine main battery hits. Kirishima sank in the early hours of 15 November.
Japanese cruisers fired torpedoes at her; all missed, and Washington came out of the battle undamaged.
The Navy's ship history calls it the first head to head battleship clash of the Pacific war.
Washington earned 13 battle stars in World War II and was sold for scrap in 1961.

declassified.fact: Willis Lee was a champion marksman before he was an admiral. At the 1920 Olympics in Antwerp he won seven shooting medals, five of them gold, a record for one Games that stood for 60 years.

body:
Rear Admiral Willis Lee was a gunnery man who had made a study of radar. On this night he needed both.

15 November 1942. Off Savo Island, Lee's Task Force 64 lost all four of its destroyers early in the fight. Then South Dakota lost electrical power and drew most of the Japanese fire, while his flagship Washington moved in unseen.

Guided by her SG search radar, Washington closed on the battleship Kirishima and opened up at about 8,400 yards, point blank range for 16 inch guns. She fired 75 main battery rounds and scored at least nine hits. Every Japanese torpedo missed, and she came through undamaged.

The Navy calls it the first head to head battleship clash of the Pacific war.
addons: Would you have trusted radar to aim your guns in the dark?
